comment: План здания первой главы (GAME_DESIGN, раздел 19). Координаты — проценты сцены 16:10. Из этого файла art/make_layout_guide.py рисует картинку-разметку для генерации фона и размеры спрайтов мест ремонта.

R12.en: A hatch found under the garage

zones.broken: doorway blocked by a pile of rubble and broken boards
zones.fixed: cleared doorway framed with fresh wooden beams and a simple door mat

zones.broken: smashed shop counter lying on its side
zones.fixed: restored shop counter patched with metal sheets, clean top with a small cash box

zones.broken: tall empty broken wall shelf, planks hanging
zones.fixed: fixed tall wall shelf stocked with tin cans, jars and olive-green food packs

zones.broken: fallen crates and a toppled rusty rack
zones.fixed: neat new metal racks with crates stacked in order

zones.broken: dusty workbench buried under junk
zones.fixed: working mechanic's workbench with a vise, hanging tools and a small lamp

zones.broken: a row of dead ceiling lamps hanging on loose wires
zones.fixed: a row of ceiling lamps glowing warm yellow on tidy wires

zones.broken: empty dry rusty water tank stand
zones.fixed: clean blue water tank on a stand with a small pump and a tap with a bucket

zones.broken: blank broken sign board hanging crooked above the entrance, no text
zones.fixed: repaired sign board lit with warm string lights, still no text

zones.broken: a rusty garage roller shutter jammed half-open, bent slats hanging down
zones.fixed: a repaired garage roller shutter rolled up neatly under the ceiling

zones.broken: an inspection pit in the floor filled with rubble and broken boards
zones.fixed: a clean inspection pit with a steel rim and a small ladder

zones.broken: a toppled rusty two-post car lift, one post leaning
zones.fixed: an upright two-post car lift, freshly painted, arms folded

zones.broken: a small caravan van with a flat tyre, open hood and missing headlight, side view facing right
zones.fixed: the same small caravan van repaired, headlights on, roof rack with tied cargo, side view facing right

zones.broken: a heavy floor hatch buried under concrete debris and a fallen beam
zones.fixed: an open heavy service hatch with a ladder going down and warm light below

zones.broken: a heap of broken bricks, planks and torn cardboard
a heap of crushed boxes, rags and bent metal
a heap of scrap metal, old tyres and broken tools
a heap of trash bags, broken pallets and a rusty barrel
a big pile of car junk: doors, bumpers, tyres and bricks
a heap of concrete chunks and twisted rebar
a heap of concrete slabs, a fallen beam and dust
a row of dead caged bulbs on a sagging cable along the ceiling
zones.fixed: a row of caged bulbs glowing warm yellow on a tidy cable

zones.broken: a heap of a collapsed metal rack, cable reels and broken crates
a dead rusty diesel backup generator with an open panel and loose wires
zones.fixed: the same backup generator running, panel closed, green indicator lights, small exhaust pipe

zones.broken: a disassembled water pump station: two rusty pumps, disconnected pipes on the floor
zones.fixed: an assembled pump station with two blue pumps, pipes connected, pressure gauges

zones.broken: a heap of grey silt, sludge buckets and rotten boards
empty filter tanks with cracked glass and dry hoses
zones.fixed: tall filter tanks full of clear water, clean hoses and a shiny tap

zones.broken: a heap of torn air ducts, grilles and dust
a huge rusty ventilation fan unit, blades jammed, ducts torn off
zones.fixed: the same ventilation unit working, fan spinning, ducts reattached, light breeze ribbons
